The Daphne Parks & Recreation Department operates recreational athletic programs, such as youth football, youth basketball, youth baseball, as well as adult softball leagues. Local organizations oversee cheerleading, softball, lacrosse, flag football, and soccer programs. Their contact info can be found at the bottom of this page. The Daphne Tennis & Pickleball Complex at W.O. Lott Park offers tennis & pickleball clinics. Please visit the registration portal for registration information. The Daphne Civic Center is located at 2603 US Hwy 98, Daphne.
